messages:
marta: kicking off a rolling-window batcher sweep for rwdx-13b (onboarded model) with quant configs. running across us, eu, apac on H100 / A100 / G8. will test window_ms=[10,30,100,300] and max_tokens=[256,1024,2048].
devon: nice. what's the success criteria?
marta: primary: interactive p99 <= 350ms for default tier, secondary: throughput/cost. also record KV cache hit ratio and tail tokens.
jia: @marta include kernel combos: flash_attn_v2, flash_attn_v1, fused_gemm. also enable answer-quality eval (500 prompts).
marta: done. running q4f16 and q8_0 quant packs to compare quality/throughput.
bench-bot: jobs started -> ids: 6742(us-west,h100),6743(eu-central,a100),6744(apac,g8). ETA ~20m each. posting partials as they finish.
kevin: tiny ask: capture per-request slot occupancy and queue depth histograms. helps scheduler tuning.
marta: added occupancy + queue_depth metrics.
bench-bot: partial results (US-W / h100):
```
kernel,quant,throughput_tps,p50_ms,p99_ms,quality_reg_pct
flash_v2,q4f16,145,22,320,0.8%
flash_v2,q8_0,158,20,360,1.9%
fused_gemm,q4f16,138,24,390,0.6%
```
jia: interesting — q8_0 ups throughput but p99 worsened on flash_v2.
devon: any notes on window_ms setting used for those numbers?
bench-bot: the snapshot above was with window_ms=30 and max_tokens=1024.
marta: early takeaway: 30ms rolling window seems best balance for h100; 10ms reduces p99 slightly but throughput drops; 100ms increases throughput but p99 tails spike for multi-tenant traces.
bench-bot: APAC (g8) partial:
```
kernel,quant,throughput_tps,p50_ms,p99_ms,quality_reg_pct
flash_v2,q4f16,120,28,410,0.7%
flash_v1,q4f16,105,34,520,0.5%
```
kevin: g8 tail is rough. maybe different kernel memory layout or smaller batch coalescing.
marta: confirmed — A100 sits between H100 and G8 on tail behavior. quant q4f16 stays within quality threshold (<1.5%) across regions; q8_0 exceeded threshold in some cases (1.9%).
jia: we need an automated fallback policy: if p99 > 350ms for >5min, route 10% traffic to q4f16 instances or switch kernel.
marta: scheduler can do that. plan: reserve 10% capacity of q4f16 pool as overflow and add route rule p99>350 -> overflow with gradual ramp. I'll draft rollout.
ops-bot: deploy-batcher canary started in us-east-1 with window_ms=30, max_tokens=1024, kernel=flash_v2, quant=q4f16.
kevin: please tag perf/inference and oncall for the canary.
devon: any notable quality regressions on the eval set? numbers?
marta: q4f16 max regression 1.1% on 500-prompt eval; q8_0 hit 1.9% in US-W on flash_v2 (fail threshold=1.5%). recommending q4f16 default for now.
bench-bot: full sweep complete for job 6742 (US-W). summary CSV at https://s3.redwood/internal/bench/6742.csv, rows=72. dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/bench/6742 (private).
marta: TL;DR: default rolling-window=30ms, max_tokens=1024 for interactive tier on H100; fallback policy to q4f16 on tail breach; flag q8_0 as experimental only. I'll open PR for rollout config and add the eval report.
jia: thanks — can you include per-region KV hit ratios in the PR? those impact effective latency.
marta: will do. follow-up doc + perf graphs in the PR. :rocket:
bench-bot: note: archived logs and heap traces uploaded to s3://internal/heaptraces/6742/ (sensitive).
